function.name: create_employee_bank_account
function.description: Create a new bank account entry for an employee. Requires bankAccountType (Checking/Savings), accountNumber (min 4 characters), bankName, and branchAddress.

iban.description: IBAN (15-34 characters, starts with country code + 2 digits)

amount.description: Amount or percentage value for allocation (must be positive, required if allocation is 'percent' or 'amount')

useForBonus.description: Whether account is used for bonuses

function.name: update_employee_bank_account
function.description: Update a bank account entry in the employee's bank accounts table. Performs a PARTIAL update - only fields provided in the input will be updated; omitted fields will retain their existing values.

entry_id.description: The bank account entry ID to update as a string (obtain from GET /people/{id}/bank-accounts endpoint)

iban.description: IBAN (15-34 characters, starts with country code + 2 digits)

amount.description: Amount or percentage value for allocation (must be positive)

useForBonus.description: Whether account is used for bonuses

function.name: delete_employee_bank_account
function.description: Delete a bank account entry from an employee's bank accounts table using soft delete. Marks the entry as deleted while preserving data for audit purposes.

entry_id.description: The bank account entry ID to delete as a string (obtain from GET /people/{id}/bank-accounts endpoint)

function.name: get_docs_folders_metadata
function.description: Return a list of all document folders with metadata.

parameters.description: This endpoint does not accept any input parameters or body.

function.name: get_docs_for_employee
function.description: Return a list of documents for a specific person that the authenticated user's permission groups are allowed to VIEW.

id.description: Person ID whose documents should be fetched.

function.name: upload_shared_document
function.description: Upload a file to a specific employee's Shared folder via URL.

id.description: Employee ID from the path parameter.

documentName.description: The name of the documentName to be stored in HiBob.

documentUrl.description: A direct file URL from your server (public or temporary signed). HiBob will call this URL to retrieve and store the document.

tags.description: Optional list of tags to assign to the document.

function.name: upload_confidential_document
function.description: Upload a file to a specific employee's Confidential folder via URL.

id.description: Employee ID from the path parameter.

documentName.description: The name of the documentName to be stored in HiBob.

documentUrl.description: A direct file URL from your server (public or temporary signed). HiBob will call this URL to retrieve and store the document.

tags.description: Optional list of tags to assign to the document.

function.name: upload_custom_document
function.description: Upload a file to a specific custom folder via URL.

id.description: Employee ID from the path parameter.

folderId.description: The UUID of the custom folder to upload to.

documentName.description: The name of the documentName to be stored in HiBob.

documentUrl.description: A direct file URL from your server (public or temporary signed). HiBob will call this URL to retrieve and store the document.

tags.description: Optional list of tags to assign to the document.

function.name: delete_shared_document
function.description: Delete a specific document from an employee's Shared folder.

id.description: Employee ID from the path parameter.

function.name: delete_confidential_document
function.description: Delete a specific document from an employee's Confidential folder.

id.description: Employee ID from the path parameter.

function.name: delete_custom_document
function.description: Delete a specific document from a custom folder.

id.description: Employee ID from the path parameter.

folderId.description: Custom folder UUID from the path parameter.

function.name: get_all_company_fields
function.description: Get all company fields metadata.

function.name: create_new_field
function.description: Create a new field.

category.description: The category of the field (cannot be 'root')

type.description: The type of field. Supported: text, text-area, number, date, list, multi-list, hierarchy-list, currency, employee-reference, document

historical.description: When true, this field keeps the history of its values. Default is false

function.name: update_existing_field
function.description: Update an existing field.

fieldId.description: The database ID of the field (e.g., 'Field001', 'Field002') - NOT the logical field_id path

function.name: delete_existing_field
function.description: Delete an existing field.

fieldId.description: The database ID of the field (e.g., 'Field001', 'Field002') - NOT the logical field_id path

function.name: get_all_company_lists
function.description: Get all company lists with their items.

includeArchived.description: Whether to include archived items in the response (default: false)

function.name: get_company_list_by_name
function.description: Get a specific company list by its name/ID.

listName.description: The internal name of the list (path parameter, e.g., 'departments', 'sites')

includeArchived.description: Whether to include archived items in the response (default: false)

function.name: add_item_to_list
function.description: Add a new item to an existing list.

listName.description: The internal name of the list (path parameter)

parentId.description: String database ID of the hierarchy parent node (optional, for nested lists only, e.g., 'name001')

function.name: update_list_item
function.description: Update an existing item in a list.

listName.description: The internal name of the list (path parameter)

itemId.description: The string database ID of the list item (path parameter, e.g., 'name001', 'name002')

name.description: Name of the item (optional, renames the item)

parentId.description: String database ID of the new hierarchy parent node (optional, moves item in hierarchy, e.g., 'name005')

function.name: delete_list_item
function.description: Delete an item from an existing list.

listName.description: The internal name of the list (path parameter)

itemId.description: The string database ID of the list item (path parameter, e.g., 'name001', 'name002')

function.name: read_all_open_tasks
function.description: List all open tasks in the system. Returns all tasks with status='open' for the organization.

function.name: read_tasks_for_employee
function.description: List tasks for a specific employee with optional status filter. Returns tasks assigned to a particular employee.

function.name: complete_task
function.description: Mark a task as complete. Changes the status of a task from 'open' to 'closed' by task ID.

taskId.description: The task ID to mark as complete (e.g., "1", "2", "3")

function.name: get_custom_tables_metadata
function.description: Get metadata for all custom tables in the organization. Returns table definitions including columns, types, and constraints.

function.name: get_custom_table_metadata
function.description: Get metadata for a specific custom table by ID. Returns table definition including columns, types, and constraints.

function.name: get_employee_custom_table_entries
function.description: Read all entries of a custom table for a specific employee. Returns all entries for an employee in a specific custom table.

function.name: create_custom_table_entry
function.description: Create new custom table entry for an employee. Creates a new entry in a custom table with all mandatory columns provided.

custom_table_id.description: The custom table ID (e.g., '1' for Expense Allowances)

function.name: update_custom_table_entry
function.description: Update existing custom table entry (PATCH behavior). Updates an existing entry in a custom table with partial updates supported.

column_data.description: Column values to update in column_<id> format (e.g., {"column_2": 850})

function.name: delete_custom_table_entry
function.description: Delete custom table entry using soft delete. Marks entry as deleted while preserving data for audit purposes.
